描述_EN: camels and horses were used as pack animals and merchants passed their goods from oasis to oasis. the victoria and albert museum has around 700 ancient and medieval textiles recovered by stein at the beginning of the twentieth century. the most notable item traded was silk. the silk road was also important for the exchange of ideas – while silk textiles travelled west from china, buddhism entered china from india in this way. the fragment was brought back from central asia by the explorer and archaeologist sir marc aurel stein (1862–1943). some are silk while others are made from the wool of a variety of different animals. this textile was recovered from an area now referred to as the silk road, a series of overland trade routes that crossed asia, from china to europe. the textiles range in date from the second century bc to the twelfth century ad.
描述_ZN: 年，骆驼和马被用作驮运动物，商人们在绿洲之间传递他们的货物。 年，维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆有大约700件古代和中世纪的纺织品，是斯坦在20世纪初找到的。 年，最引人注目的贸易项目是丝绸。 年：丝绸之路对思想交流也很重要--当丝绸纺织品从中国向西运输时，佛教也通过这种方式从印度进入中国。 年：这块碎片由探险家和考古学家Marc Aurel Stein先生（1862-1943）从中亚带回来。 有些是丝绸，有些则是由各种不同动物的羊毛制成。 这个纺织品是从现在被称为丝绸之路的地区找到的，这是一系列横跨亚洲的陆上贸易路线，从中国到欧洲。 这些纺织品的年代从公元前二世纪到公元十二世纪不等。
